title: PushTopic - Data API
description: Represents a query that is the basis for notifying Streaming API clients of changes to records in an org. This object is available in API version 21.0 and later.

ApiVersion.description: API version to use for executing the query specified in Query. It must be an API version greater than 20.0. If your query applies to a custom object from a package, this value must match the package's ApiVersion.Example value: 66.0

Description.description: Description of the PushTopic. Limit: 400 characters

IsActive.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsActive.description: Indicates whether the record currently counts towards the organization's allocation.

Name.description: Descriptive name of the PushTopic, such as MyNewCases or TeamUpdatedContacts. Limit: 25 characters. This value identifies the channel and must be unique.

NotifyForFields.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
NotifyForFields.description: Specifies which fields are evaluated to generate a notification. Possible values are: All Referenced (default) Select Where

NotifyForOperationCreate.description: true if a create operation should generate a notification, otherwise, false. Defaults to true. This field is available in API version 29.0 and later.

NotifyForOperationDelete.description: true if a delete operation should generate a notification, otherwise, false. Defaults to true. Clients must connect using the cometd/29.0 (or later) Streaming API endpoint to receive delete and undelete event notifications. This field is available in API version 29.0 and later.

NotifyForOperationUndelete.description: true if an undelete operation should generate a notification, otherwise, false. Defaults to true. Clients must connect using the cometd/29.0 (or later) Streaming API endpoint to receive delete and undelete event notifications. This field is available in API version 29.0 and later.

NotifyForOperationUpdate.description: true if an update operation should generate a notification, otherwise, false. Defaults to true. This field is available in API version 29.0 and later.

NotifyForOperations.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
NotifyForOperations.description: Specifies which record events may generate a notification.In API version 29.0 and later, this field is read-only, and doesn’t contain information about delete and undelete events. Use NotifyForOperationCreate, NotifyForOperationDelete, NotifyForOperationUndelete and NotifyForOperationUpdate to specify which record events should generate a notification. Possible values are: All (default) Create Extended Update A value of Extended means that neither create or update operations are set to generate events.

Query.description: The SOQL query statement that determines which record changes trigger events to be sent to the channel. Limit: 1,300 characters
